dedupe_keys.name: a geospatial dataset of public electric vehicle charging infrastructure in indonesia

description: A Geospatial Dataset of Public Electric Vehicle Charging Infrastructure in Indonesia is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Richard Wiputra, Sherly Santiadi (Binus University). A geocoded inventory of Indonesia's public electric vehicle charging stations, locally known as SPKLU (Stasiun Pengisian Kendaraan Listrik Umum). It contains 2,454 unique charging sites, 3,767 charger boxes, 7,593 chargers and 4,665 connectors, representing 89,871 kW of installed fast-charging-capable power across all 34 provinces under the pre-2022 structure. Coverage: national (ID); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-NC-3.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
